fullName.value: LIM and calponin homology domains-containing protein 1

texts.value: Actin stress fibers-associated protein that activates non-muscle myosin IIa. Activates the non-muscle myosin IIa complex by promoting the phosphorylation of its regulatory subunit MRLC/MYL9. Through the activation of non-muscle myosin IIa, positively regulates actin stress fibers assembly and stabilizes focal adhesions. It therefore negatively regulates cell spreading and cell migration
Interacts with MYH9; independently of the integration of MYH9 into the myosin complex
